description: The SAM AI model is a research prototype designed to screen for insecure attachment in children aged 5 to 9 years using speech recordings.

instances.assertion: The SAM AI model is a research prototype designed to screen for insecure attachment in children aged 5 to 9 years using speech recordings.
The SAM model uses a multimodal Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to screen for insecure attachment styles in children aged 5-9.
SAM is a research prototype that predicts insecure attachment styles in children aged 5-9 using speech recordings.
The SAM AI model predicts secure or insecure attachment styles from speech recordings of children aged 5 to 9.
